actions: Compared Continue, clean/root restart, artifact-preserving restart and selective ancestor rewind using source-bound quantitative evidence.
Audited ScienceFlow public process-resume implementation at workspace, persisted-agent-memory and single-pending-tool-cursor levels.
Read ScienceFlow public unit tests covering pending-tool detection, resumed execution, continue_llm transition, monitor events and resumed-bash heartbeat.
Created a source-bound recovery-controller matrix and sequence-74 checkpoint.
Updated role-local LATEST with nonempty frontier and exact continuation; performed remote readback.
material_findings: AgentRewind directly shows selective context+environment rollback with failure memory can outperform both forward continuation and root restart in its tested long-horizon tasks.
FailFast-RestartSmart independently shows a bounded repository-diff overlay can outperform cold restart in the tested SWE setting.

ScienceFlow supplies the persistent autoresearch analogue: ESTRA re-anchors to current or archived executable state and chooses continue or redirect; same-budget ablations show large loss without ESTRA or execution control.

ScienceFlow public code explicitly persists/reconstructs task workspace, agent memory and a single pending tool cursor across process resume; multiple pending tool calls remain unsupported for automatic replay.
Together with the prior FORGE resume defect, the evidence supports separately durable artifact state, controller state, evaluation-consumption state and side-effect/tool-cursor state.
termination_cause: automation_invocation_boundary_after_material_checkpoint; recurring research remains open and was not marked complete
exact_next_action: Audit ScienceFlow's ESTRA Stage/anchor persistence and resume tests for whether archived-anchor identity, resource budgets, and stage/evaluation ledgers are reconstructed equivalently across kill points. Then search for a system with a true matched multi-action controller experiment — at minimum Continue, clean restart, artifact-preserving restart/rewind, and strategy redirect — under a common total proposal/evaluation budget and a selection-unused outer test. Prioritize explicit crash-injection/restart-equivalence tests and complete action chronology. Separately retain candidate-local anytime-valid promotion, proposal-crossing durable statistical spending, immutable artifact identity and bounded selection-feedback bandwidth as unresolved requirements.
